text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, guess what! Earlier, my tea stalk
floated
upright, and I drew a fortune
that said "great
blessing"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Those are signs that I'm going to
conquer the Twinkle Series by sheer
luck, don't you think?!
The great
Shiraoki has ordained it all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
